summary: A fixed type role for headline numbers, --ui-text-figure: 24/30 at 600, tracking-tight (with -weight, -leading, -tracking companions), emitted as text-figure. Fixed, not fluid: title-lg computes about 17px on a phone inside a stat tile that does not shrink. Decided on the Stat tiles and Chart card sheet (2026-11-11). The Tailwind emitter now takes its type sizes from TYPE_ROLES itself rather than a name pattern, which had minted --color-ink-figure, a colour whose value is 1.5rem. theme-zero.css is regenerated.
